title: Clock Stopped at the Alarm
content: The astronomical clock stopped at 8:47, the same minute set on the alarm dial, tying the patron's death to the clock's mechanism rather than a random intrusion.

title: Empty Gear Socket
content: A removable brass gear is missing from the calendar train. The empty socket is clean and freshly oiled, so the gear was taken recently.

title: Weight-Shaped Injury
content: The patron's injury matches the rounded edge of a clock weight, supporting a mechanical strike rather than a fistfight or a weapon brought from outside.

title: Thread-Marked Latch
content: Wax residue and scratches on the door latch show it could be set from outside with a fine thread, making the locked room appear sealed after the killer left.

title: Secretary Reported the Lock First
content: Nora did not test the handle herself until after Crispin Hale announced the door was locked, meaning the earliest claim about the locked room came from a suspect.

title: Ledger Threatened the Secretary
content: The patron planned to review Hale's accounts before signing a new trust, giving the secretary a direct reason to fear exposure that very evening.

title: Blueprint Gear Note
content: The missing gear would stall the visible calendar motion but would not prevent the alarm weight from releasing, explaining how the clock could stop while still causing harm.

title: Fresh Oil on the Ladder
content: Fresh clock oil on the ladder suggests someone recently climbed to reach either the clock's upper access panel or the high window.

title: Numbered Gear Slot Empty
content: The workshop's parts tray is missing gear number nineteen, the same size required by the empty socket in the astronomical clock.

title: Convenient Alley Footprint
content: A single clean footprint points away from the broken window, inviting the conclusion that an intruder fled into the alley.

title: Glass in the Drawn Curtain
content: Glass caught inside the drawn curtain proves the window was broken from within after the curtain was closed, making the alley escape a staged false trail.

title: Gear in the Secretary's Folio
content: The missing number nineteen brass gear is hidden in Crispin Hale's folio, still oily and matching the clock's empty socket and the workshop parts tray.
